title: Quantum Model Parallelism for MRI-Based Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Stages
abstract: arXiv:2602.00128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With increasing life expectancy, AD has become a major global health concern. While classical AI-based methods have been developed for early diagnosis and stage classification of AD, growing data volumes and limited computational resources necessitate faster, more efficient approaches. Quantum-based AI methods, which leverage superposition and entanglement principles along with high-dimensional Hilbert space, can surpass classical approaches' limitations and offer higher accuracy for high-dimensional, heterogeneous, and noisy data. In this study, a Quantum-Based Parallel Model (QBPM) architecture is proposed for the efficient classification of AD stages using MRI datasets, inspired by the principles of classical model parallelism. The proposed model leverages quantum advantages by employing two distinct quantum circuits, each incorporating rotational and entanglement blocks, running in parallel on the same quantum simulator. translated_title: 基于MRI的阿尔茨海默病分期分类的量子模型并行化
translated_abstract: 随着预期寿命的不断增长，阿尔茨海默病已成为一个重要的全球性健康问题。虽然基于经典人工智能的方法已被开发用于阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断和分期分类，但不断增长的数据量和有限的计算资源使得更快、更高效的方法成为必要。基于量子的AI方法利用叠加和纠缠原理以及高维希尔伯特空间，能够突破经典方法的局限性，为高维、异构和含噪数据提供更高的准确率。本研究受经典模型并行化原理的启发，提出了一种基于量子的并行模型（QBPM）架构，用于利用MRI数据集对阿尔茨海默病分期进行高效分类。所提出的模型通过采用两个不同的量子电路来利用量子优势，每个电路都包含旋转块和纠缠块，并在同一量子模拟器上并行运行。
tldr: 本研究提出一种量子并行模型（QBPM）架构，通过两个包含旋转块和纠缠块的量子电路在同一量子模拟器上并行运行，实现对基于MRI的阿尔茨海默病分期的高效分类。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a Quantum-Based Parallel Model (QBPM) architecture that leverages two distinct quantum circuits with rotational and entanglement blocks running in parallel on the same quantum simulator to efficiently classify Alzheimer's disease stages using MRI datasets.
